en.headline: Canada's Hong Kong PR pathways close to new applications today
en.dek: Ottawa will stop taking new Stream A and Stream B filings after 31 August; applications already received will still be processed, Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada said.
body: Canada's temporary permanent-residence pathways for Hong Kong residents stop accepting new applications on Monday, 31 August, Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada said in a notice issued on Friday.

The department said filings received on or before the deadline will continue to be processed. The two streams, opened in June 2021, were aimed at Hong Kong residents in Canada with qualifying recent study or work experience.

As of 30 June, the department said it had received about 30,315 applications covering 48,560 people. More than 8,600 applications had been approved, involving 13,485 people, and about 13,370 people had obtained permanent resident status.
People who have already applied and are waiting for a decision may still seek an open work permit of up to three years under a public policy that runs until May 2029, the department said.

zh.headline: 加拿大港人永久居留途徑今日截止接受新申請
zh.dek: 移民部確認Stream A及Stream B於8月31日停止收新表，限期或之前遞交的申請會繼續審理；截至6月底約1.3萬人已取得永久居民身分。
body: 加拿大移民、難民及公民部上周五公布，專為香港居民而設的臨時永久居留途徑將於8月31日（周一）起停止接受新申請。
部門表示，在截止日期或之前收到的申請會繼續處理。兩條途徑（Stream A及Stream B）於2021年6月開通，對象為身在加拿大、具備合資格近期學歷或工作經驗的香港居民。
截至今年6月30日，當局共接獲約30,315宗申請，涉及48,560人；逾8,600宗申請獲批，涉及13,485人，約13,370人已取得永久居民身分。
移民部指，已遞交永久居留申請、仍在等候結果的合資格人士，仍可按現行公共政策申請最長三年的開放式工作許可，該安排維持至2029年5月。
